project_context.vibe: Dark cinematic, high-end, mysterious but user-friendly and trustworthy

primary_heading.usage: H1, H2, large numbers, and marquee text. Must be UPPERCASE.

body_font.usage: Paragraphs, buttons, small labels, UI elements.

colors.archetype: LUXURY (Premium, Depth, Mystery) mixed with HIGH-CONTRAST

visual_enhancers.noise_texture: MANDATORY: Add a fixed, pointer-events-none div covering the viewport with a subtle SVG noise/grain background to give a filmic, cinematic quality.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for the sticky header and floating UI cards. `bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10`. NEVER use fully transparent headers.
visual_enhancers.spotlight_effect: Use radial gradients in the background (e.g. `bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_center,rgba(245,184,65,0.08)_0%,transparent_50%)]`) to spotlight key sections like the hero and forms.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px subtle white/10 borders for containers. For active/hover states, transition to the amber brand color.

layouts_and_grids.hero_section: 100vh Sticky/Fixed layout. The text must use a masked line-by-line reveal on load. As the user scrolls, use framer-motion `useScroll` and `useTransform` to scale and translate absolute-positioned images (camera lens, microphone, BTS photo) outward from the center, simulating a 3D unpacking sequence.
layouts_and_grids.thumbnail_gallery: Horizontal side-scrolling section. Use a wide flex container with `useScroll` mapped to a horizontal translation (`x`). Clip the frames aggressively.
layouts_and_grids.podcast_teasers: Render a sleek Phone Mockup frame. Inside it, put the teaser video. Implement a framer-motion `drag='x'` interaction to allow users to 'right swipe' through different podcast teasers.
layouts_and_grids.services_grid: Bento Grid Protocol: High-density asymmetric grid (e.g., `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4`). 13 services means varying spans. On hover, cards should slightly lift and their border should glow with the brand color.
layouts_and_grids.manifesto_chapters: Large typographic numbers (Oswald) overlapping the text. High contrast, massive negative space.
layouts_and_grids.marquee: Use `react-fast-marquee`. Font: Oswald, completely uppercase, hollow (text stroke) or solid amber. Very slow speed.

motion.scroll_reveal: Wrap major sections in motion.div elements with `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40 }}` and `whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`. Use `viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}`.
motion.hover_states: All buttons and interactive cards must scale up slightly (`scale: 1.02`) and brighten on hover.

components.lead_capture_form: Use Shadcn UI Input, Textarea, Button. Override default styles to match cinematic theme: `bg-white/5`, `border-white/10`, focus states should use `ring-primary`. Layout: Split screen - massive typography on the left, sleek form on the right.
components.interactive_cards: For the services. Custom HTML/Tailwind divs wrapped in framer-motion for the hover logic.
components.video_player: For the teaser. Autoplay, muted, loop inside the phone mockup container.

thumbnail_3_v.usage: Vertical asset for gallery or bento grid.

bts_photo.usage: Behind the scenes / Manifesto section or Hero unpacking parallax.

cinematic_lens.usage: Abstract floating asset for the 3D-feel Hero unpacking sequence.

cinematic_mic.usage: Abstract floating asset for the 3D-feel Hero unpacking sequence.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast standards. Dark grey text on black is forbidden; use #A3A3A3 or lighter.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Use `useReducedMotion` from framer-motion to disable the 3D unpack sequence and scroll-jacking for users with vestibular disorders.
accessibility.test_ids: Every button, form input, and swipeable card MUST have a `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid='hero-cta'`, `data-testid='contact-submit'`).

instructions_to_main_agent.1: BUILD .js FILES, NOT .tsx. Provide the exact CSS variables and custom classes.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: NO GENERIC SLOP. The design must look like a high-end film production agency. Spacing should be extremely generous (py-24, py-32).
instructions_to_main_agent.3: For the Hero '3D unpack' requirement: Since we don't have literal 3D models, you MUST simulate this by using layered absolute `motion.div`s containing the mic, lens, and BTS images. Map their `scale`, `y`, and `x` values to `useScroll` so they 'fly out' from the center as the user scrolls down, revealing the UI beneath.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Never use a fully transparent header; use backdrop-blur-xl and bg-black/50.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do not leave placeholder links or text. Construct the 13 services logically: Outdoor Podcast Production, Multi-Camera Setup, Video Editing, etc.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Use Radix/Shadcn primitives for form elements to ensure accessibility, but heavily style them with Tailwind to fit the cinematic theme.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic layouts and simplistic gradients. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters. DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). DO NOT center align the app container. Use sonner for toasts. Do not use AI emojis.
